title: Subarrays
statement: The task is to count subarrays of an array of n positive integers (n up to 2·10^5, values up to 10^9) whose sum is divisible by k and whose length is strictly greater than k. It reduces to counting pairs of equal prefix sums modulo k at least k+1 positions apart, using a hash map of remainder counts filled with a lag of k+1.
